name: Zonos AI
description: Zonos, by Zyphra, generates natural voices and clones a voice from a short sample, with control over emotion, speed and pitch. The weights are released as open source.

howToUse.title: Access Zonos AI
howToUse.description: Go to the Zonos AI website and access its open-source TTS features.

howToUse.title: Clone or Select Voice
howToUse.description: Clone a voice with a short sample or choose from available voices.

howToUse.title: Generate Speech
howToUse.description: Type or upload text to generate audio in your chosen voice.

howToUse.title: Download Output
howToUse.description: Export your audio files for use in projects or content.
